description: The BattleBall lobby (bb_lobby_1): LOUNGEINFO and GAMEPLAYERINFO on G_STAT, GETINSTANCELIST, INITIATECREATEGAME (GAMEPARAMETERS), GAMEPARAMETERVALUES (a bad map, a bad parameter, a game made), OBSERVEINSTANCE, INITIATEJOINGAME (bad team, joining, switching teams, a full team), STARTGAME (not the creator, one team only), KICKPLAYER, WATCHGAME and joining from there, LEAVEGAME, a second game, the creator leaving a waiting game (deleted for everyone), the ticket checks, UNOBSERVEINSTANCE and REQUEST_GAME_LOBBY
